Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

The app has data-oriented layout/view-model infrastructure and the golden fixture exists, but the audit did not find the named DataFirstRun FX acceptance route proving the complete DataEmpty board. In particular, bundled-example opening, whole-window drops, required/recommended source affordances, local-only explanation, untitled state, and recent-project presentation need one user-facing journey rather than scattered components. Keep the fake-backed preamble boundary: this ticket can be completed against FakeStudyBackend; it does not wait for native S3.7 E2E.

Evidence:
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/layout/StudioLayouts.scala:93
- docs/studio/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:912
- fixtures/studio-golden/SCORES.json:1

Remaining / next action: Implement and run the named first-run board/journey, including bundled fixture opening, without adding a real-backend prerequisite.

Disposition: Keep open.
